runtime: Actual Lua 5.1 modules; export-only Auctionator flow, read-only AH quotes and simulated receipts; no live purchases

results.name: X skill levels aggregate all route steps, subtract bags once and retain trainer fees
Invalid level counts are rejected and valid goals clamp to trained cap
Incomplete routes are labeled partial and missing prices never become free
Commodity sample sums price tiers and item export never opens a buy dialog
Confirmed commodity receipt credits mail once and delivery replaces that credit
Cancellation buys nothing; explicit failure removes reserved credit
Reload/disconnect uncertainty prevents duplicate buys until explicit reconciliation
Partial commodity stock and whole item stacks disclose shortages/surplus
Item buyout uses matching auction ID and only successful receipt credits stock
Changing a sample cannot trigger a purchase; own and bid-only listings are excluded
Export uses current bag shortfall and blocks stale skills or combat without buying
AH closure, throttle, timeout, unrelated searches and profession changes invalidate review
Shopping pauses scanner; starting a cost scan invalidates shopping sample
Active native confirmation prevents changing transactions or clearing credit
Saved shopping list is stable through price changes; rebuilding keeps mail credit
Auctionator advanced search receives exact localized names and net missing quantities
Auctionator export refuses uncached names, stale skills and API failure without losing list
Auctionator commodity and item buyouts credit receipts without reopening PP over Auctionator
Auctionator purchases outside the exported materials and bids are not credited
Auctionator export preserves an active native confirmation and requires tracking
Missing Auctionator preserves the list and never falls back to Blizzard buy methods
Export without checking prices sends only the selected material and never credits a purchase
